text: I visited him last night and the interview was final.” Louis turned quite pale, but did not move. I resumed triumphantly, “There are yet three people to be interviewed in the interests of Mr. Wilde and myself. They are my cousin Louis, Mr. Hawberk, and his daughter Constance.” Louis sprang to his feet and I arose also, and flung the paper marked with the Yellow Sign to the ground. “Oh, I don’t need that to tell you what I have to say,” I cried, with a laugh of triumph. “You must renounce the crown to me, do you hear, to me.” Louis looked at me with a startled air, but recovering himself said kindly, “Of course I renounce the—what is it I must renounce?” “The crown,” I said angrily.
